classification_coverage.multi_label_explanation: Reviews can match multiple complaint themes when commuters report multiple issues in one review (1 multi-label and 1 single-label low-star reviews, totaling 3 theme assignments across 2 matched low-star reviews). Each theme count reflects distinct matching reviews (reviewId) and must not be summed as mutually exclusive.

components.name: Complaint Frequency
components.description: 1–5 scale based on theme share of focus reviews in the Primary window, capped by absolute review count (count=1 -> max 1; count=2 -> max 2; count<5 -> max 3; count<10 -> max 4) so tiny samples cannot produce high frequency scores.

components.name: Severity & Commuter Impact
components.description: 1–5 scale measuring journey blockage (5 = physical safety or total app launch/integrity lockout; 4 = missed pickup, auth logout, or auto-cancelled ride; 3 = prompt/support friction; 2 = UI usability). Missing review data is never interpreted as zero severity.

components.name: Recent vs. Preceding Trend
components.description: 1–5 scale from percentage-point shift (Recent rate minus Preceding rate). Requires n >= 10 relevant reviews and >= 10 matching theme reviews per comparison window; otherwise held at neutral T=3 ('Insufficient evidence' or 'No baseline available').

components.name: Classification & Coverage Confidence
components.description: 1–5 scale combining verified review match count, specificity/detail, and window coverage representativeness (capped at <= 2 when historical coverage is incomplete/biased or theme count < 3).

components.name: Feasibility & Implementation Ease
components.description: 1–5 scale where higher values indicate faster engineering/operational turnaround (5 = UI modal/config change; 4 = client auth/integrity/UX fix; 3 = crash/tracking/schedule fix; 2 = multi-stop routing solver or multi-vendor ops).

safeguard_rules: Zero-Review Rule: Themes with 0 matching reviews receive Priority Score = None ('Unranked (0 Reviews)') and are separated into preventative monitoring guardrails.
Separate Safety Escalation: Credible safety incidents (T01 count > 0) are escalated on a dedicated Safety Escalation track rather than competing solely on weighted score.
Root-Cause Hypothesis Rule: All technical causes inferred from review text are labeled as hypotheses requiring internal product/operations telemetry confirmation.

data_limitations: Rating vs. review sentiment: The official Google Play rating reflects all ratings, while sentiment analysis is based on the written reviews collected for the selected period.
Data coverage: Review coverage varies by date. Older reviews may come from sampled results, so the analysis may not represent every review in the selected period.
Theme overlap: A review may mention multiple problems. Issue counts can overlap and should not be added together.
Evidence threshold: Trends are reported only when enough relevant reviews are available; otherwise, the report states that evidence is insufficient.

themes_and_recommendations.ease_rationale: Easy-to-Moderate (4/5): Caching active trip details/OTP offline and extending session refresh grace periods are standard client-side resilience improvements.
themes_and_recommendations.symptom_summary: Delayed or missing SMS/email login OTPs, corporate SSO mapping errors, and automatic session logouts in low-network parking zones right when the boarding OTP is needed.
themes_and_recommendations.root_cause_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS — REQUIRES TELEMETRY CONFIRMATION] Auth interceptor clearing local session tokens on transient network timeouts instead of retaining cached trip state, plus SMS gateway delivery throttling.
themes_and_recommendations.telemetry_check: Inspect auth token refresh error codes (HTTP 401 vs. network timeout), session duration before logout, and SMS/email OTP delivery latency logs.
themes_and_recommendations.user_problem: Commuters are unexpectedly logged out when entering low-network zones (basements/parking) and face delayed or failed SMS/Email login OTPs when trying to sign back in.
themes_and_recommendations.supporting_evidence_summary: 0/2 low-star reviews (0.0%) and 0/3 total reviews in 01 Mar 2019 – 30 Aug 2022. No direct review evidence in this period.
themes_and_recommendations.why_important: An unexpected logout at pickup time without OTP delivery prevents employees from accessing their boarding pass or driver contact when standing in low-signal pickup zones.
themes_and_recommendations.first_concrete_action: Preserve local authenticated sessions across transient network timeouts (avoiding token wipe on offline errors) and retain read-only offline access to the active trip pass during commute windows.
themes_and_recommendations.validation_metric: Cut unexpected auto-logout and OTP failure complaints by >= 50% over 90 days and achieve >= 98.5% OTP delivery within 15 seconds across SMS and corporate Email.
themes_and_recommendations.missing_telemetry_to_confirm: Auth token refresh error codes (401 vs. network timeout), session duration distribution prior to logout, and SMS/Email gateway delivery latency logs.
themes_and_recommendations.proposed_fix: Preserve local authenticated sessions across transient network timeouts (avoiding token wipe on offline errors) and retain read-only offline access to the active trip pass during commute windows.
themes_and_recommendations.provisional_target: Cut unexpected auto-logout and OTP failure complaints by >= 50% over 90 days and achieve >= 98.5% OTP delivery within 15 seconds across SMS and corporate Email.
themes_and_recommendations.shared_evidence_note: No direct review evidence in this period. Absence of sampled Play Store reviews does not prove this issue does not exist in production; verify via internal telemetry.
